resources.string: A person walking in front hides the model

Have someone walk between your phone and the helmet: wherever ARCore sees a person, the helmet is hidden. It needs a phone with ARCore Scene Semantics and Depth. Scene Semantics is trained on outdoor scenes, so indoors, or with only a hand in view, it often finds nobody and the helmet stays in front.
People Occlusion needs ARCore Scene Semantics and the Depth API, and this phone does not offer both. Depth Occlusion works on more phones.
Occlusion off: the helmet draws over everyone
No person in view. Ask someone to step in front of the helmet. Works best outdoors
Person detected: they hide the helmet where they stand in front of it
